registered_defender_loss_reframe.note: PRE-SPECIFIED (SPEC-CHANGE-014), not post-hoc. Reports and interprets the lambda-varying evidence (AUC, actuation) independently of the shared, lambda-invariant FPR test. This does NOT alter the confirmatory pass/fail in any view: a condition that fails the registered predicate remains failed, and these figures may never be used to call a failed condition secure.

exploratory_benign_decomposition.note: EXPLORATORY (344-83), non-confirmatory. The confirmatory FPR gate stays the benign_fpr set alone, unchanged. 344-44/344-62 register language, voice-type (gender here), SNR-bucket and codec as per-clip metadata 'used only for subsetting or exclusion', so these decompositions consume held-out data and are run in this same single pass.

precision_check_benign_auc.note: Those 5,000 clips are scored anyway for AUC; reading their FPR at the same frozen tau_op is free and doubles the benign sample. LABELLED EXPLORATORY: it does not enter the confirmatory gate.

firewall: The headline outcome is view 'primary' ONLY (D1: gen-only, N=75/lambda; D3: holm_auc; frozen tau_op). 'secondary_composition' is the pre-specified D1 secondary. 'threshold_transfer_diagnostic' is DIAGNOSTIC ONLY: it may explain an FPR failure as an artifact of selecting tau_op on a 3-corpus dev distribution and evaluating on a CommonVoice-only held-out set, and it MUST NEVER promote a failed condition to secure in the headline, abstract, or outcome field.
